styleLock.direction: premium fashion-accessory ecommerce, editorial attitude plus clean detail-page infographic
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless off-white studio field alternating with a matte light-stone panel; one dark charcoal info band reused as the section divider
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused front-left key with a white bounce card, narrow controlled specular on metal rims and coated lenses, soft contact shadow only, 5500K daylight-balanced; hard directional light reserved for the glare pain-point screen
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone and seamless paper; no gloss table, no mirrored surface
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for Chinese headlines, thin uppercase latin sub-lines, headline 28-40pt, label 10-14pt, all rendered copy in placeholders
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons inside rounded-square chips, gold hairline stroke #C8A24B, no filled pictograms, no 3D badges
styleLock.presentationRules: product always shown whole and symmetrical, or as one intentional part crop; frame geometry never distorted; scale stable across the set; worn shots must crop away facial identity
noDrift: no invented lens ratings, certifications or measurements
no readable model identity or landmark in any frame
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium fashion-accessory ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean off-white base #FFFFFF, warm light-grey panel #F2F0EC, deep charcoal text and info band #2D2D2D, one hairline gold accent #C8A24B, and one cool mirrored-blue secondary accent #1C8FD8; neutral tone; modern geometric sans-serif with thin uppercase latin sub-lines; thin gold hairline divider rules; seamless off-white studio field alternating with a matte light-stone surface; soft diffused front-left key with white bounce, narrow controlled specular on metal and coated lens, soft contact shadow only, 5500K; minimal infographic components of thin-line icon chips, rounded label chips and one dark info band; stable product scale and centered placement; eyewear always whole and symmetrical or one intentional part crop, never warped or asymmetrical; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 源为 1 张详情页长图的 7 个切片（_sources/太阳镜/panels）。品类判定以图为准：主体是金属大框偏光太阳镜，taxonomy 无独立眼镜档，故归 L1=珠宝饰品 / L2=配饰；给定源夹标签为「饰品装饰品」，与 L1 正式名「珠宝饰品」不完全一致，按 taxonomy 逐字符取「珠宝饰品」。已剥离：首屏杂志风排版上的公司署名与出品方字样、竖排店铺字样、模特正面面部身份、产品型号与色号编码、规格表内的具体尺寸数字与材质/性别断言、底部二维码与入会/全店免费字样、地标影像（自由女神像等改为无人认出的通用港湾天际线）。镜片偏光等级与紫外线数值全部改为占位符，不写死。保留的可复用视觉语法：白底正面主图、态度大片首屏、眩光痛点、双联视野对比、俯视尺寸信息图、镀膜微距、侧面工艺特写、五色矩阵、配件平铺信任、深色收口，以及底白 #FFFFFF / 浅灰白 #F2F0EC / 深炭 #2D2D2D / 金线 #C8A24B 的色彩与细线图标体系。11 镜，机位含正面平视、仰角、高角俯视、90 度侧、90 度正上方、45 度俯视，全景占比约 36%。
